models_evaluated: XGBoost classifier (urine culture positivity prediction) with NLP-derived UTI signs and symptoms

links.outcome: Model and physician over/underdiagnosis rates and cross-group variance across intersectional age, sex, race, ethnicity groups
links.effect: Model had lower overdiagnosis and underdiagnosis than physicians in each intersectional group; cross-group CV accuracy 0.039 vs physicians 0.080; DOR CV 0.48 vs 0.33, showing variable performance across groups.
links.quote: At a diagnostic threshold of 28%, the model had lower rates of overdiagnosis and underdiagnosis than physicians for each intersectional group.

screen.reason: Retrospective cohort study evaluating an AI model (XGBoost + NLP) for UTI diagnosis and assessing performance/equity across intersectional demographic groups compared to physician baseline; does not test a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
